line: Crowley's account of the Thoth Tarot: a pictorial picture of the Universe, built on the Holy Qabalah.

sections.title: What Crowley says the Tarot is
sections.line: Crowley opens with the pack as a pictorial representation of the Forces of Nature, and calls it a symbolic picture of the Universe.

quotes.quote: THE TAROT is a Pictorial representation of the Forces of Nature
Tarot is that it is an admirable symbolic picture of the Universe, based on the data of the Holy

sections.title: The map behind the pack
sections.line: The pack's arrangement is tied, in Crowley's text, to the Tree of Life as a map of the Universe.

quotes.quote: This picture represents the Tree of Life, which is a map of the Universe.
necessitated, as will appear later, by the structure of the universe, and in particular of the Solar System, as symbolized by the Holy Qabalah.

sections.title: What the pack is built from
sections.line: The three parts of the pack, the small cards, the trumps and the suits, each answer to a part of the scheme in his account.

quotes.quote: These ten numbers are represented in the Tarot by the forty small cards.
These are divided into four suits according to the four elements.

sections.title: What is not claimed here
sections.line: Crowley's book is the only source for this pack on these pages. Its practical purpose is his statement, and the field does not read the pack as a Jungian object.
